about: The gauntlet. Rows run in order; the next wave starts when every opponent of this one is dead.

columns.opponents: opponent ids (opponents sheet), one fighter each
columns.announce: announcer id (announcer sheet) played when the wave starts
columns.delay_s: seconds between the previous wave ending (or gauntlet start) and the spawn
columns.spawn_distance_cm: how far in front of the player they appear
columns.spread_cm: sideways gap between fighters of the same wave
